body: This conflicts with main. Please run /resolve-conflicts (or `git merge upstream/main`, keep both sides) and push. The usual cause is that both sides added lines in the same place.

Merged main to resolve conflicts (crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell.rs: keep both sides, #738 align_pick_viz paint + #709 vertex_pick marks). Targeted gate: align_compose, plane_align, points_align, ui setup_align/axis/plane/points, plane_face_pick, vertex_pick tests green; clippy -D warnings clean on app/ui. Ready for a re-check (/resolve-conflicts check).

Merged main to resolve conflicts (crates/ui/src/state.rs: keep both sides; main's HolderPick import kept, AlignPartToSetup import dropped as unused since the align flow moved to state_align.rs). Targeted gate: ui lib tests 536 pass (serial), clippy -p camcraft-app/ui --lib --tests -D warnings clean. Ready for a re-check (/resolve-conflicts check).

Merged main (62a2c93a) to resolve conflicts. One file: `crates/ui/src/lib.rs` - both sides added a module line at the same place; kept both (`pub mod align_pick_viz;` yours, `pub(crate) mod machine_modes;` main's). Targeted gate: `cargo check -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-app --all-targets` green, ui lib tests 599/599 on merge commit 01e07569. Ready for a re-check (/resolve-conflicts check).

Merged main into this branch (head 01e07569 -> 3b9ef781) to clear the conflicts. Hand-resolved, keeping both sides: crates/app/src/pick.rs (this PR's lay_on_plane_in / lay_on_points_in exports plus main's align_from_axes and box_pick exports); crates/ui/src/state.rs (the Lay/Align arms stay in state_align.rs from this PR; main's TurnPartInPlane -> AlignPartFromAxes rename applied to the dispatch list and to state_align.rs, which now calls align_from_axes); crates/ui/src/plane_pick.rs (this PR's plain-words edge refusal with main's 'Part axes' wording); crates/ui/src/egui_app/setup_axis_pick.rs (Apply axes tooltip combines 'from where it sits now' with main's right-hand-rule text). Tests: camcraft-app align_compose, plane_align, points_align, plane_align_edges, mcp_align_axes, winding_align all pass; camcraft-ui lib 73 setup/axis/plane/points tests plus 12 structural/declutter tests pass; clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings clean. No snapshot PNGs touched. Awaiting a review of this head.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 3b9ef7817b347e532e175488108aedeec6ff02b5 -->
**Verdict: Needs changes before merge (one small request: screenshots).** Code and tests look ready.

**What looks good**
- The hand-resolved merge is sound. Both sides are kept: main's `AlignPartFromAxes` and `align_from_axes` stay, routed through `state_align.rs::dispatch_align` (arm at `state.rs:3479-3483`). No `TurnPartInPlane` or `turn_part_in_plane` remains anywhere in `crates/` or `docs/`. `pick.rs` exports both main's `axis` items and the new `lay_on_*_in`. `plane_pick.rs`, `axis_pick.rs` and `setup_axis_pick.rs` keep main's logic plus the new wording.
- Compose-on-held-pose is clean: `onto_held` snaps a zero step back to the held alignment bit for bit, and `turned_by` and `held_centre` refuse non-finite results and a missing part by name. There is no new `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic`.
- Every move is still one undoable `AlignPartToSetup`. The decision record `docs/decisions/738-align-flow.md` is present, new modules carry provenance lines, and the `align_stock.rs` and `state_align.rs` splits shrink large files.
- No snapshot PNG, `CHANGELOG.md`, `Cargo.toml`, `build.rs`, `.github/` or process-file change, so no `PROCESS_VERSION` bump is needed.

**Local results** (merged with current main; the branch was already up to date, so the tree is the reviewed head)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| app lib | 160 passed |
| align_compose / plane_align / plane_align_edges / points_align | 3 / 9 / 5 / 8 passed |
| axis_align / align_axes / setup_align / turn_pivot | 10 / 9 / 10 / 5 passed |
| commands_undo / mcp_setup / wcs_align / winding_align | 30 / 8 / 5 / 9 passed |
| setup_carry / setup_relative / project_roundtrip / pick | 9 / 9 / 73 / 9 passed |
| ui lib (from `crates/ui`) | 647 passed, 5 ignored, 0 failed |
| clippy `-D warnings`, camcraft-app + camcraft-ui, all targets | clean |

**Requested before merge**
1. The PR changes how the Setups page looks (pick rows and wording, tooltips, and the new fill, disc and bold-edge alignment viz) but the description has no screenshots. Please add before/after screenshots to the PR description (not snapshot PNGs in the branch), including a tilted face and the narrow properties pane that the "Not exercised" list names.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- MCP `lay_part_on_points` and `lay_part_on_plane` now compose too, as the body says. That is a behaviour change for agents, so the camcraft-mcp skill rows could mention it.
- `state.rs` is still over 4,300 lines (it is smaller than before this PR, so it is not blocking).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 3b9ef7817b347e532e175488108aedeec6ff02b5 -->
The reviewer withdraws the requested change of the earlier comment. The review of this head is clean: code, merge resolution, tests and clippy.

The before/after screenshots of the Setups page changes are still asked for in the PR description, and the PR is held from the merge batch until they are there. No code change or push is needed.

Merged main twice into this branch (head 3b9ef781 -> 8845b68d). Nothing was rebased or force-pushed.

Hand-resolved:
- crates/app/src/pick.rs: kept this PR's lay_on_plane_in / lay_on_points_in exports and main's circle and centre exports.
- crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell.rs: main's version taken (line endings differ), then this PR's one align_pick_viz::paint call put back.

Follow-up commit "fix(ui): fold main's page wording into the alignment fix". Main's page wording now wins where main's tests pin it. The compose-on-current-pose behaviour and its commands and tests are untouched.
- setup_align_pick.rs: the row label is "Part alignment" again, with the flow text as its tooltip. "Turn by" is back to "Turn" and the "Start from a preset" label is gone. The page is one line shorter, so the pick rows fit the narrow pane again.
- setup_plane_pick.rs: the empty state reads "Picked: nothing picked yet" again. A non-empty pick still shows the count.
- axis_pick.rs: the picks_text readout is main's wording again ("1 of 2 points on ...", "edge on ..."). The no-internal-id refusal wording stays.

Tests changed to main's wording (each still pins the same behaviour):
- setup_axis_tests (points and edge readout)
- setup_plane_tests (empty pick status)
- setup_align_tests (the header is still drawn)
- plane_face_pick (the axis row names the edge)

Main's 4 failing tests now pass: centre_pick_tests::an_axis_by_two_points_drafts_a_round_edge_and_reads_out_its_centre, setup_settings_page::the_armed_pick_rows_stay_inside_their_groups, setup_settings_page::the_setup_page_is_laid_out_in_groups_like_the_wcs_page, structural::setup_page_alignment_rows_structure. No test was deleted and no snapshot PNG changed.

Tests: `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main` is green on the final head (app suites and ui suites). camcraft-ui lib: 737 passed. `cargo check` of app and ui with all targets is clean.

Not exercised: the GUI by hand, screenshots (still owed in the PR description), clippy.

`merge-plan --delta` reports NEW CODE (hand-resolved merge plus the fold commit). Ready for a re-check.

Merged current main into the branch. New head d9ece53ab.

Hand-resolved: crates/ui/src/egui_app/setup_align_tests.rs. Both sides appended a test at the same spot (this PR's a_preset_after_a_face_lay_composes_and_as_modelled_is_the_one_reset, main's model_bounds_anchors_are_the_parts_never_the_vise). Kept both, no assertion dropped. state.rs merged automatically.

Gate: camcraft-ui lib tests for setup_align, setup_axis, setup_plane, setup_points, plane_face_pick all pass; clippy -D warnings clean.

Not exercised: other suites, the GUI, snapshots. Ready for a re-check.

<!-- pr-reviewer: d9ece53ab9dc697da7476c34e2f0a38c676528dd -->
Delta review of the merge d9ece53 only (on top of 8845b68, whose delta review was clean). `git log 8845b68..d9ece53` is a merge of main plus main's own commits.

The remerge-diff touches only `crates/ui/src/egui_app/setup_align_tests.rs`. It removes the conflict markers, keeps both tests (`a_preset_after_a_face_lay_composes_and_as_modelled_is_the_one_reset` from this PR, `model_bounds_anchors_are_the_parts_never_the_vise` from main) with every assertion intact, and adds one closing brace plus a blank line. No other code.

The refresh agent reports its gate: five camcraft-ui lib filters and clippy green.

Not exercised: other suites, GUI, screenshots.
